question: Which of the following is NOT a warm water current?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Humboldt current.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Humboldt current**

 
 
• ​The Humboldt Current is also called the **Peru Current.**
 
• It is a cold, low-salinity ocean current that flows north along the western coast of South America.
 
• It is an eastern boundary current flowing in the direction of the equator, and extends 500–1,000 km offshore.
 
• The Humboldt Current is named after the German naturalist Alexander von Humboldt.
 
• The Humboldt Current is a highly productive ecosystem.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kurushio current**

 
 
• **​**The Kuroshio Current is one of the major ocean **warm water currents.**
 
• It begins east of the Philippines then flows in a northeastward direction past Taiwan and Japan.
 
• It forms the western side of the clockwise **North Pacific Ocean gyre.** 
 
• The surface waters of the Kuroshio Current are warm and salty.
 
 
 
• **Alaskan current**
 
 
• The Alaska Current is a southwestern shallow warm-water current.
 
• It is alongside the west coast of the North American continent.
 
• The Alaska Current produces large clockwise eddies at two sites:
 
 
• **west of the Haida Gwaii**
 
• **west of Sitka, Alaska **
 
 
 
 
 
• **Tsushima current**
 
 
• ​Tsushima current is a **warm water current.**
 
• Tsushima Current flows north, mixing with the Kuroshio Current, waters of the East China Sea from coastal China.
 
• Tsushima current is a surface current with warm, high-salinity, low nutrient water.
